liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dupree's Diamond Blues** (1 review): Weir's guitar effects pedal sounded like a steel drum set; Dupree's is cited as Weir at his worst [18]
- **Deal** (1 review): Attendee names Deal and Miracle>Bertha as probably favorite versions [23]
- **I Need A Miracle** (1 review): Reviewer calls this the best Miracle in recent memory [15]
- **China Doll** (1 review): China Doll is very trippy and long, more so than the Playin' in the Band jam [13]
- **Black Peter** (1 review): Playin' emerges from an odd drums/space segment into an inspired Black Peter [13]
- **Aiko Aiko** (1 review): A good Aiko Aiko opens things, and China Doll is quite fine [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1984-06-09.176743.neumann.km84i.bradt.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 140 min [1]
- **gd1984-06-09.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.77322.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 138 min; rated 4.25/5 by 4 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the sound amazing and the board has an outside-like quality, especially in Playin' [19]
- **gd1984-06-09.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.106006.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 137 min; rated 2.75/5 by 4 [4]. Said about its sound: Sound isn't superb; Jerry's guitar burns throughout and his voice is semi-haggard but better than other nights [18]
- **gd1984-06-09.151073.fob.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac1648**: source not stated; 19 songs; 142 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [6]
- **gd84-06-09.set1-sbd.miller.14950.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 7 songs; 52 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [11]. Said about its sound: Reviewer hears cuts in the recording and vocal flubs, calling the first set unremarkable [12]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended, gave a ticket to an older friend for his birthday; Phil was low in the mix early, then got loud [21]
- Attendee recalls cuts in the sound system during Iko Iko [23]
- Vocals jump in on Deal, which happens often throughout the show [4]
- The PA had issues all show, especially the first three songs; a vocal mic was out for one first verse [8]
- A loud man rambled in the tapers section at the start of one tune; mics were kept below shoulder level [8]
- Attendee says this show was much better than the next day's, with Jerry playing nearly flawlessly [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1984-06-09.176743.neumann.km84i.bradt.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Bill Bradt; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Bill Bradt's Master Audience Cassettes: Neumann KM84i mics > Sony D5M (Maxell MX-90) [1]. Also: Master soundboard cassette from Bill Bradt and Kathy Weir Bradt, transferred by Charlie Miller; Nakamichi 700 source patches 0:09 in Space [1]
- **gd1984-06-09.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.77322.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Transferred/Edited by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Nakamichi 550/Maxell XLIIS-90); Cassette Master (Sony TC-WE475) -> Sony R500 (Pass Through) -> SEK'D Prodif Plus -> Samplitude… [3]
- **gd1984-06-09.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.106006.flac16**: taped by Joani Walker and Paul Scotton; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Nakamichi 550/Maxell XLIIS-90) [4]. Also: Tapes from Joani Walker and Paul Scotton, with pitch correction help from Joe B. Jones [4]
- **gd1984-06-09.151073.fob.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Recorded by Bob Wagner; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Bob Wagner's Master (FOB) Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony D6 [6]. Also: Master front-of-board cassettes from Bob Wagner, transferred by Charlie Miller; Beyer M88 source patches Space and the Keep Your Day Job encore [6]
- **gd84-06-09.set1-sbd.miller.14950.sbeok.shnf**: source: Set 1 SBD -> Cm -> Dat -> MiniDisc -> Samplitude -> CD Recording Info:SBD -> Cm -> Dat [11]
